mintAuthority.summary: WEUSD has independent native issuance on BSC, Base, Arbitrum, Plume, and Movement. The PicWe admin EOA is an uncapped EVM native minter/admin across the four EVM deployments, while the Movement package publisher controls the native mint/redeem modules and their undelayed compatible upgrades. PicWe's self-built burn/mint bridge contract, relayer, and bridge-module upgrade surface are assessed separately under bridgeRouteRisk.

controls.label: PicWe BSC published native mint/redeem contract
controls.evidence: Independently retrieved 2026-10-20 at BSC block 125063414, hash 0xbab0708773795ff028a6da5f7562f2265dd413c1be529d3926919e5569c93ea8, timestamp 2026-10-01T07:50:06Z: hasRole(keccak256(MINTER_ROLE),0x5d54f1092fd1750a3ab96972dc1867c5b23ef22c) on canonical WEUSD returned true and eth_getCode returned 13149 bytes. The issuer directory names this exact 40-hex-digit contract, whereas the earlier exclusion omitted the final C. Verified WeUSDMintRedeem source exposes public mintWeUSD against its configured stablecoin and an ADMIN_ROLE-controlled setStablecoin, plus cross-chain reserve withdrawal and accounting functions. This records the positively identified BSC native mint path only; no immutable collateral gate, complete execution inventory, new signer independence or current all-chain reserve reconciliation is asserted. The separately retained issuer EOA's unrestricted mint/admin powers remain binding.

controls.label: PicWe WEUSD Movement package publisher
controls.evidence: At Movement ledger version 196018785 / block height 85281248, the PicWe account 0xf39c2674014dc3b3af9fd77f31ac69aa9398d8031f2c13a73fccbaca65641ff6 had package picwe at upgrade_number 0 with compatible upgrade policy 1 and an authentication key equal to the publishing account. This is the native Movement mint/redeem authority for weusd_mint_redeem and can publish compatible replacements with no on-chain timelock. The same package contains weusd_cross_chain_gas; that bridge-module upgrade capability is separately represented under Bridge Risk, while this Mint Authority control covers the native mint-critical package path. The EVM WEUSD contracts on BSC, Base, Arbitrum, and Plume have zero EIP-1967 implementation slots and are not proxies.

review.evidence: Historical August 16 observations are preserved without renewal: the issuer EOA 0xc12233455beac4e094a5de022be692a264c0c0bc holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINTER_ROLE on native EVM WEUSD deployments, and Movement ledger version 196018785 / height 85281248 identifies a compatibly upgradeable native mint/redeem package controlled by its publisher. Cross-Chain 0x4b3495391ebb170af31185aed7bb4dfa903ed1fd, the Movement cross_mint_role_contract relayer and the publisher's bridge-module powers remain Bridge Risk machinery. Issuer mint/admin powers and the undelayed native package-upgrade path retain unbounded economics. FD21 correction on 2026-10-20: the earlier native mint/redeem exclusion used a truncated address ending F22 instead of the issuer-published 40-digit address ending F22C. Independent exact archived reads establish MINTER_ROLE=true and 13149 runtime bytes at the correct address on BSC block 125063414 (2026-10-01T07:50:06Z), Base block 50067179 (2026-08-16T23:41:45Z), Arbitrum block 495300024 (2026-08-16T23:44:24Z) and Plume block 87694882 (2026-08-16T23:44:35Z). All four observed minter runtimes are byte-equal; each native control is separately chain-qualified with its own original pin. This repairs the demonstrated exclusion, not an exhaustive controller census. The exact verified minter source allows public deposits against its configured stablecoin, but ADMIN_ROLE can change that token; no construction-enforced economic cap is inferred. The October 20 issuer documentation still contains no dated reserve inventory or recurring whole-liability reconciliation spanning EVM and Movement native issuance. Reconciliation remains unknown, supervision is unchanged, and all independently established issuer EOA/upgrade adverse powers remain. Original aggregate review start and sibling control pins are preserved. FIX-ROUND1 correction 2026-10-20: change supervision none to unknown because no positive-absence establishment is recorded. The retrieved https://docs.picwe.org/what-is-weusd describes 1:1 USDC collateral and real-time auditability but does not establish either a named whole-liability independent attestor or the absence of supervision. This supersedes supervision is unchanged above; no favorable process credit, authority renewal or reserve-solvency finding follows.
